headline: Marketing Analytics Specialist
summary: Marketing analytics specialist with four years at an e-commerce company in Parañaque. I measure campaign performance in Google Analytics and Google Ads, analyse sales and traffic data in Excel, and build Power BI reports that show marketing which channels pay off. I bridge the marketing and data teams.
highlights: Built the marketing performance report in Power BI that replaced six weekly spreadsheets.
Found that 30% of paid search spend went to low-converting keywords and helped move it to better ones.
Set up conversion tracking across the website and app for the first time.
